entry.title: 7 November 2026: 71 changes shipped
entry.content:
• Free project checks now show results as they load, with evidence cards on location, price per m2, developer record and local law.
  • The satellite card now picks the newest picture with a clear view around the pin location.
  • Project pages now show construction progress from space, using monthly satellite images and a chart set against the developer's own dates.
  • The buyer portal now compares the payments you have made with how far the building has progressed.
  • A new map shows links between developers, such as a shared company, registry number or address.
  • Sign-up from translated check pages no longer lands on a missing page, and the country count is now the same everywhere (94).

Summary of the day's commits, checked by code.

entry.title: 6 November 2026: 34 changes shipped
entry.content:
• You can now click a spot on the map to look up official property registers, with a check that works on phones.
  • Uploaded PDFs are checked for signs of tampering, and developer photos are checked for date, location and reused images.
  • Price per m2 can now be compared with official data, and a developer's company network is shown on its page.
  • Developers can have their replies verified, and a viewer shows what changed on a project page, including on phones.
  • Search for named projects is instant in 8 languages, and you can watch a project with one click.
  • You can check many registers at once with the new bulk check, shown as cards on phones.

Summary of the day's commits, checked by code.

entry.title: 4 November 2026: 67 changes shipped
entry.content:
• You can now check a developer for insolvency records and look up whether a property agent is licensed.
  • Hazard checks now show flood scenarios for 2030 and 2050, plus protected land and mangroves within 1 km of a project.
  • New delivery-delay page and on-time odds lookup show how likely a project is to hand over on schedule.
  • A promise tracker, plain-language search alerts and a list of questions to ask the developer are now available.
  • A new satellite page uses night lights to spot ghost projects, where nothing visibly changes on site.
  • The check, scoring, checklist, about and cases pages are now available in Russian, Chinese, German, French, Arabic and Dutch.

Summary of the day's commits, checked by code.

entry.title: 3 November 2026: 124 changes shipped
entry.content:
• Kolaboro hazards: live point lookup from open sources (Copernicus DEM, Aqueduct floods, USGS, NOAA tsunami, GVP volcanoes, OSM coastline) and zoning service probe
  • Kolaboro.com provenance: panel status classes no longer collide with site.css .ok; manifest 'starting' state answers 200 (no console error)
  • Live State of Off-Plan report computed in the browser from the Parquet file, with code and SQL under every chart; property test results
  • Email_off around the 20 pages that show an email, so Cloudflare no longer injects its email-decode script (it carries no CSP nonce)
  • Desk review repairs malformed model JSON and falls back to the second reader; eval summary check v2 targets the injected claims
  • Nonce on scripts injected after kbHeaders (/admin, /check, ssr JSON-LD), private cache for /p/ /m/, 60 s cache for /data/*.json

Summary taken from the day's commit subjects.

entry.title: 2 November 2026: 26 changes shipped
entry.content:
• If you paste a link that is not a property project, the check now says so clearly instead of giving a score.
  • The buyer portal is now available in Spanish, including the language switch, dates, prompts and messages.
  • The portal can read a payment plan with AI. You can also download your data and delete your account.
  • Answers from our open data now carry a digital signature, and a public log lets anyone check that the data was not changed.
  • On phones, the portal has a bottom bar and a compact header, and findings can be swiped.
  • The home page was redesigned. The comparison of buying alone and buying with Kolaboro is now visual, in all 7 languages.

Summary of the day's commits, checked by code.

entry.title: 1 November 2026: 86 changes shipped
entry.content:

  • Off-plan Transparency Index (73 markets ranked live, method, top and bottom 5, sortable table, citation, CSV) and embeddable market widget for journalists (/embed/?m=)

entry.title: 31 October 2026: 8 changes shipped
entry.content:
• Project cards now show, for each check, whether it is confirmed, not confirmed, contradicted or backed by a registry, plus how many claims were tested.
  • All 328 projects now have all 6 checks, covering 73 markets in 52 countries.
  • Live cases now show 100% public (6 of 6) or exactly which checks are missing. There is also a new 100% filter.
  • After a check, you can share the result by link, save it as a PDF, and get an email follow-up.
  • The sample report is lighter and has photos you can swipe through, a to-do list you can tick, and a share-with-lawyer button.
  • A new security page explains who sees your case and how it is stored. A refund line now sits next to prices.

Summary of the day's commits, checked by code.
